## About
Imported Motor Cars is Pete Oraha's shop on the east side frontage road in Santee, between the Mission Gorge and Riverford Rd. exits. When you bring your car in, you talk to the person who actually works on it.
Pete grew up in Northern Iraq, where his father taught him the value of hard work, keeping your word and being faithful to the people you serve. After coming to the United States, he earned a degree in automotive mechanics from the Lincoln Institute of Automotive Technology and built a busy shop in Chicago before moving to the San Diego area.
Today he works on fine imported cars, from everyday drivers to exotic and older cars, and he has served auto collectors and the San Diego Automotive Museum in Balboa Park. The shop holds a 4.1 rating from 39 Google reviews.

## Services
- Complete auto electrical: Diagnosis and repair of electrical problems, including battery and charging systems, lights, power windows, power seats and sunroofs.
- Computerized engine diagnostics and tune-up: Computer diagnostics hardware and software for a quick, complete look at what is wrong and why.
- Brake services, including ABS: Electronic diagnosis of anti-lock brakes and traction control systems for accurate repairs.
- Regular transmission evaluation: Checking transmission fluids and electronic solenoids to catch problems before they leave you stranded.
- Exhaust and emission evaluation: A look at exhaust, tune-up and emission problems ahead of your smog check.
- Steering and axle work: Steering, wheel alignment, rear axle and differential work for a car that handles smoothly and safely.
- Oil and lubrication systems: Oil service with your car's service reminder reset so you know when the next one is due.
- Exotic and old cars: Restoring exotic or older cars, or keeping them in mint condition mechanically and electrically.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: You can call Pete to set up a service appointment, or just stop by the shop.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're on Woodside Ave in Santee, on the east side frontage road between the Mission Gorge and Riverford Rd. exits.

Q: What if I don't see the service I need?
A: Just ask. If it isn't on the list, call and tell Pete what your car needs.
